review_scope: Read-only static review of supervisor14 child run_group and terminal-continuation loader scopes, the graph-owned runtime-loaders14 module, and the focused synthetic regressions. No production replay, admission, materialization, analyzer, build, or launch was performed.

findings.detail: The production supervisor dereferences graph.module("runtime_loaders14") around executor.run_group at supervisor14 lines 989-994 and around terminal continuation safety at lines 1223-1228. The current pinned graph contract does not contain this role: bridge09.REQUIRED_GRAPH_NAMES is the fixed eleven-role tuple and its allowed extras are only disk_guard and stage_runtime01 (bridge09 lines 40-63); replacement14.RUNTIME_GRAPH_NAMES is the same eleven roles (replacement14 lines 526-530), and validate_runtime_core only requires that roster (lines 547-565). The current supervisor prepare_graph calls pass only host supervisor/protocol/admission/bridge modules (lines 1141-1143 and 886-888). Therefore a production graph constructed from the current core has no runtime_loaders14 member and the first child or terminal scope fails with a missing graph member before the intended frozen operation.
findings.impact: The synthetic scope tests pass with an ad-hoc Graph containing runtime_loaders14, but they do not prove that the sealed production core can construct the module. Child dispatch and terminal continuation are unreachable until the role is explicitly added to the final graph/core/source-input closure.
findings.required_correction: Add the exact runtime-loaders14 path and SHA as a bound graph member/source input in the successor core and contract, preserve deterministic graph ordering and source closure, and have the final manifest bind that same member. The production graph must load it through bridge09's hash/path checks; do not import it ad hoc or fall back to an arbitrary module. Re-run a real graph-construction fixture with the final roster before any production admission.

findings.detail: The loader scope is fail-closed for unknown names and paths and checks each selected member's source SHA and module __file__. However, _PinnedUtil.spec_from_file_location selects the first graph member with the requested canonical path when module_names is omitted (runtime-loaders14 lines 69-91), while the graph contract permits same-source aliases. Supervisor14 supplies no module_names at either scope. The exact-source check prevents byte substitution, but path/SHA equality alone does not identify which distinct module instance a loader name is meant to use when a final graph contains duplicate aliases for one helper path.
findings.impact: This is safe only if the final graph proves one member per LOADERS path, or the final dispatch supplies a reviewed name-to-member binding. A per-path first-member fallback must not be treated as proof of exact module identity for an aliased helper.
findings.required_correction: In the final core/manifest either enforce uniqueness of every LOADERS path across graph members or bind the reviewed loader names through module_names and validate those names against the sealed graph. Add positive and near-miss coverage for duplicate-path aliases; do not broaden path lookup or silently import a new module.

positive_checks.detail: The child scope encloses the frozen contract, fresh-attempt and per-source guards plus executor.run_group, and restores executor import/lock/clock/contender bindings in finally. The scope asserts graph ownership of the executor and runtime-loader module before use.
The terminal continuation safety call is inside the same graph-owned scope around the successor's exact executor object, before write_completion finalizes the successor.

runtime-loaders14 rejects unknown loader names, wrong paths, foreign specs/modules, symlink sources, source mutation, nested scopes, and changed executor import bindings; stage-runtime's pinned import facade likewise resolves only exact graph paths and rejects unregistered paths.

tests.scope: synthetic temporary graph only; includes an ad-hoc runtime_loaders14 member
temporary fixture only; test graph.module returns a synthetic runtime-loader facade and does not validate the sealed production graph roster

claim_limit: The focused tests establish restoration and fail-closed synthetic loader behavior only. They do not establish production graph construction, analyzer qualification, or execution readiness.
